description: Annual formation – 2018 is a dataset listed in SBB open data platform, an open data platform of a railway operator, published or maintained by SBB (Swiss Federal Railways). Datenset ist nur bis zum Fahrplanwechsel so vorhanden - dann wird der Inhalt im Bestehenden drin sein. ----------- Die Formation ist die Zusammenstellung von Fahrzeugtypen zu einem Zug der SBB. Die Formation sagt nicht aus in welcher Richtung die Wagen aufgereiht sind (ob die Lokomotive an der Zugspitze oder am Zugsende aufgereiht ist). Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Verkehr, Rollmaterial. The portal shows 2017-11-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://data.sbb.ch/page/licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sbb-open-data-portal.
